collectables.name: Reins of the Abyssal Lurker

collectables.name: Reins of the Velvet Saber

collectables.name: Reins of the Ledger Tortoise

collectables.name: Reins of the Silkwind Strider

collectables.name: Reins of the Goldtusk Boar

collectables.name: Reins of the Platinum Direwolf

collectables.name: Reins of the Ruby Scorpid

collectables.name: Reins of the Golden Dromedary

collectables.name: Reins of the Obsidian Rhino

collectables.name: Reins of the Jadehorn Elk

collectables.name: Reins of the Gilded Mechanostrider

collectables.name: Reins of the Crowned Grizzly

collectables.name: Reins of the Emerald Basilisk

collectables.name: Kesten's First Volume
collectables.blurb: The first bound volume of Kesten's record of the Scourge, in pencil. The last page has your name on it, written properly, with the day he swore to you.

collectables.name: Adrián's Whistle
collectables.blurb: The referee's whistle Adrián carried in his left pocket from the day he landed. He says he doesn't need to be the referee when he's with you.

collectables.name: Omar's Red Pen
collectables.blurb: The pen Omar gave Tarek as a joke the year they met, the one he marked Tarek's drawings with. It's nearly dry. Tarek says Omar's name is in the well now.

collectables.name: Freja's Pinard Horn
collectables.blurb: The wooden midwife's horn Freja had in her pocket the night the worlds joined, polished dark from years of use. William carved her a new one, so this one's yours.

collectables.name: Diego's Blue Spudger
collectables.blurb: The little blue plastic tool Diego used to open phones at a kiosk in Maracaibo, worn white at the tip. He has proper tools now, but this was the first one.

collectables.name: Ama's Nurse's Watch
collectables.blurb: The fob watch Ama wore pinned upside down on her uniform for fourteen years of nights. It still keeps time. She says somebody should keep track of when you last slept.

collectables.name: Marcus's Weather Meter
collectables.blurb: The handheld weather meter Marcus had clipped to his belt the day the worlds joined. The battery died in the first month and he carried it for three years anyway.

collectables.name: Sondre's Shackle Key
collectables.blurb: The little dinghy shackle key Sondre wore every day for four summers on the Hardangerfjord, worn smooth. He says he'll get another one when he finds a boat.

collectables.name: Nélida's Chimichurri Card
collectables.blurb: Sebastián's grandmother's chimichurri recipe in her own handwriting, stained with oil. He knows it by heart and wants it somewhere safe.

collectables.name: The Key He Was Cutting
collectables.blurb: A half-cut brass key from Marco's shop in Naples, still in his hand when he landed. It doesn't open anything. He says he's finished it now, in his way.

collectables.name: Sophia's Parliament Pass
collectables.blurb: Sophia's European Parliament pass on its blue lanyard, the photo faded. It got her into the booth every morning for fourteen years. She doesn't need to prove who she is any more.

collectables.name: Seu Raimundo's Compass
collectables.blurb: Carolina's grandfather's brass compass, carried on the Amazon every day and never used. She doesn't need north any more. She knows which way is downstream.

collectables.name: Ryan's First-Bonus Watch
collectables.blurb: A heavy gold watch Ryan bought with his first bonus in Boston. He's out of the business now, and a man who's out doesn't need to know what time the markets open.

collectables.name: Hana's Patrol Cap
collectables.blurb: Hana's red and yellow surf lifeguard's cap, faded nearly pink by fourteen summers on the beach at Port Waikato. She's on patrol here now.

collectables.name: Esteban's Radiation Badge
collectables.blurb: The badge Esteban wore on his collar through nineteen years of surgery under X-ray, its window long gone black. It counted the dose for years. Now the clauses do.

collectables.name: Berat's Mouth Mirror
collectables.blurb: The angled chrome dental mirror Berat kept behind his ear in his surgery in Izmir. Used twice for teeth and forty times to see round corners.

collectables.name: Dan's Hi-Vis Vest
collectables.blurb: The faded orange high-visibility vest Dan landed in, from his first week at a warehouse in Sheffield. He's on a proper crew now, so he doesn't need to be seen.

collectables.name: Marisol's Reading Glasses
collectables.blurb: Folding reading glasses in a scratched hard case, from the end of every night shift in Bogotá. She's got four beds to look after now.

collectables.name: Silas's Two-Euro Coin
collectables.blurb: A Belgian two-euro coin worn smooth from three years of being flipped for every decision Silas didn't want to make. He makes his own now.

collectables.name: Rosa's Binoculars
collectables.blurb: Battered field binoculars from eight years in the Tanzanian bush, the strap mended three times. Rosa's learned to see what's coming without them.

collectables.name: Pavlo's Tea Flask
collectables.blurb: A dented steel flask with no lid, given to Pavlo by his wife on his first day as a teacher. He'd like it to go somewhere that isn't a wall.

collectables.name: Amber's Soil Knife
collectables.blurb: A worn steel soil knife with a wooden handle, for digging plugs of sedge on the Oregon tide flats. Amber does most of her planting with her hands now.

collectables.name: Ivan's Cab Key
collectables.blurb: The heavy brass key to the driver's cab of Ivan's tram on Route 13 in Novosibirsk. He has a proper route now and doesn't need to pretend.

collectables.name: Haruto's Brush Roll
collectables.blurb: A bamboo roll of calligraphy brushes, his master's and his own. Haruto's hand won't hold them much longer, and he wanted them kept by someone who saw why they mattered.

collectables.name: Marta's Oil Can
collectables.blurb: A small brass oil can, dented and shiny from Marta's hand, carried on the Łódź sewing floor for nineteen years. She has a whole workshop of oil now.

collectables.name: Dona Zuleide's Candle List
collectables.blurb: Lúcia's grandmother's list of everybody on their street in Goiânia, folded soft. The names are written on her candle wall now.

collectables.name: Linh's Tuning Fork
collectables.blurb: A steel tuning fork tuned to A, its tines worn bright. Minh's daughter gave it to him so he'd have her note with him. He doesn't need to strike it to hear it any more.

collectables.name: Ak-Kanat's Glove
collectables.blurb: Bakyt's thick leather eagle-hunting glove, worn shiny, which carried his first eagle for twenty-two years in the Tian Shan. It should go to someone who knows what it carried.

collectables.name: His Father's Ticket Punch
collectables.blurb: A brass bus conductor's ticket punch, Matías's father's, clicked twice before every fight for three years. He doesn't need to start a shift any more.

collectables.name: Tomas's Carabiner
collectables.blurb: A steel climbing carabiner scratched to bare metal, clipped to Tomas's belt through eighteen years of rigging and the night he fell forty feet into this world.

collectables.name: Cristóbal's Brigadista Helmet
collectables.blurb: A scorched and dented yellow wildfire helmet, the one Cristóbal walked out of a Barrens grass fire in on his first day. His brigade have helmets of their own now.

collectables.name: Callum's Snake Hook
collectables.blurb: A steel snake hook with a worn grip, used every day at a Queensland reptile sanctuary. Callum handles things with his own hands now.

collectables.name: The Lead Ewe's Bell
collectables.blurb: A small dented brass bell from the lead ewe of Giorgi's flock in Kazbegi, carried knotted silent for three years. It's untied now, so it can ring.

collectables.name: Camille's Spoke Wrench
collectables.blurb: A slim silver bicycle-spoke wrench on a battered keyring, used to true wheels in Lyon. Never mention that she gave it to you.

collectables.name: Liam's Trauma Shears
collectables.blurb: Blunt-nosed paramedic's shears with HARTIGAN scratched into one handle. Liam's crew have their own now, and two kids who'll want to borrow them.

collectables.name: Anjali's Hand Lens
collectables.blurb: A brass botanist's hand lens on a cord, scratched from forty years of field seasons. Anjali says you should look closely at things.

collectables.name: Orlando's Straight Razor
collectables.blurb: A pearl-handled barber's razor, used every day in Santurce for eleven years. It cut the hair of everybody Orlando loved.

collectables.name: Owen's CB Handset
collectables.blurb: The handset from Owen's lorry radio, its coiled cord snapped off, talked into through eight years of night driving. He'd rather talk to you.

collectables.name: His Uncle's First Pick
collectables.blurb: The oldest pick in Emre's uncle's roll, given to him at nine to open a stuck deadbolt in Istanbul, worn thin and bright.

collectables.name: Saoirse's Sliotar
collectables.blurb: A scuffed, grass-stained camogie ball from Saoirse's last county season, thrown at the party for three years. You've caught it enough times to keep it.

collectables.name: Pasang's Ice Axe
collectables.blurb: A wooden-handled ice axe carried on nineteen expeditions above eight thousand metres. Pasang says it's climbed enough, and you should have something that's been to the top.

collectables.name: Nicolás's Tourniquet Windlass
collectables.blurb: The folding windlass from a paramedic's tourniquet, clipped to Nicolás's jacket on the bike in Lima. It's stopped a lot of bleeding.

collectables.name: Iker's Txapela
collectables.blurb: Iker's grandfather's black Basque beret, worn for every pelota match he played. The coach doesn't wear the beret. The champion does.

collectables.name: Mateo's Red Headlamp
collectables.blurb: A battered red-filtered headlamp from seventeen years of nights in an observatory dome above the Elqui valley. You should look up more.

collectables.name: Imelda's Hand Wraps
collectables.blurb: Soft cotton hand wraps from a gym above a tyre shop in Navotas, washed to grey and rewound every morning for nineteen years. They were tight enough.

collectables.name: Ileana's Shoulder Rest
collectables.blurb: The black curved shoulder rest from Ileana's violin in Cluj, strapped to her back for three years with no violin to put it on. It waited long enough.

collectables.name: Tegan's Old Bell
collectables.blurb: The little brass falconry bell and leather swivel Tegan wore in Brecon. Her old bell should go to somebody she trusts.

collectables.name: Henrik's Scale Rule
collectables.blurb: A triangular aluminium engineer's scale rule from a building site in Copenhagen, worn smooth. Check before you stand on it.

collectables.name: Eino's Marking Tape
collectables.blurb: A strip of orange forestry marking tape, faded to salmon, the kind that marks trees to be left standing. Eino marked you as one to leave standing.

collectables.name: Driss's Torque Wrench
collectables.blurb: A short, stubby torque wrench from a Land Cruiser's toolkit, in Driss's hand under a truck in the Sahara when the worlds joined. You've got further to go than he has.

collectables.name: Thiago's Blue Tape
collectables.blurb: The last few turns of a roll of bright blue kinesiology tape from a clinic in Belo Horizonte, rationed for three years. It's for the fourth.

collectables.name: Jun-seo's Welding Shade
collectables.blurb: A flip-up welder's shade from a Busan shipyard, cracked across one lens. Jun-seo would like to look at things properly now.

collectables.name: Skye's Helmet Torch
collectables.blurb: A yellow, smoke-stained torch from a Country Fire Authority helmet, dead for years. Skye can make her own light now, and you should have something to laugh at.

collectables.name: Enzo's Fencing Glove
collectables.blurb: A white sabre glove from a fencing salle in Naples, never worn here. It belonged to a man who did it on his own.

collectables.name: Alonso's Kiln Goggles
collectables.blurb: Smoked-glass goggles from a Talavera pottery workshop in Puebla, for looking into the fire. Something for looking straight at hard things.

collectables.name: The Double Six
collectables.blurb: A cast-iron domino tile, double six, from a kafana in Novi Sad. Mila has the rest of the set now, and the second bowl's full.

collectables.name: Gunnar's Hydrometer
collectables.blurb: A brass brewer's hydrometer in a worn leather sleeve, from a brewery in Akureyri. Something to measure how good things are.

collectables.name: Kourosh's Silver Pencil
collectables.blurb: A slim silver mechanical pencil, finishing a sum in a Tehran office when the worlds joined. Write something that isn't a calculation.

collectables.name: El Relámpago de Plata's First Mask
collectables.blurb: Héctor's first lucha mask, black with silver flames, sewn by his wife for his debut at twenty. Faded and patched. Only family should have it.

collectables.name: Ziad's Earplug
collectables.blurb: A single foam earplug on a cord, for sleeping in an ambulance between calls in Beirut. Something for blocking out the noise.

collectables.name: Ratih's Gauge Plate
collectables.blurb: A small brass river-gauge plate stamped with depth marks, torn off a flood marker in Sumatra and sewn to Ratih's sleeve for years. It marked how high the water came.

collectables.name: Fiona's Survival Whistle
collectables.blurb: The yellow whistle from an orange helicopter survival suit, on a fraying lanyard. Fiona was flying out to a North Sea rig when the worlds joined. You might need someone to hear you.

collectables.name: Hurra's Hood
collectables.blurb: A small tooled leather falconer's hood, sized for a saker falcon Khalid flew for eleven years in Al Ain. The first Hurra would want it to go somewhere quiet.
